S30.28.needs: a Free or paid account on a model where Office file creation is allowed (the Output row is disabled otherwise)
S30.28.note: The quoted Code line is stale; the export is done by the create_office_file tool (format pptx) in apps/web/lib/services/managed-office-file-service.ts, which the chat calls and attaches as a generated file for download. The plus button has no visible text, only an icon with that accessible name, and the card's download button label was only partly confirmed in the source (the card's own button has no visible text; "Download" is the preview button text).
steps: Sign in and open a new chat on a model that supports Office file creation.
Click the plus icon in the composer (its accessible name is "Add attachments and tools").
Click "Output", then click "Presentation" so it is checked.
Type a short request such as "Make a 3-slide deck about our launch plan" and send it.
When the reply shows a generated file card, click "Download" on the card (or open the preview and click "Download").
Open the downloaded file in PowerPoint or Keynote and compare with Expected: it should be a .pptx file.
S30.28.where: Chat (first screen after sign-in) > composer "Add attachments and tools" (plus icon) > Output > Presentation, then send a message asking for a slide deck
